description: Add a variant (language + optional partner logo) to a presentation. Required: presentation_id, language (e.g. 'de','en'). Optional: partner_logo, label, slide_order (array of slide ids = talk order; default = slide positions). Returns { variant_id }.

partner_logo.description: Partner logo shown in this variant

slide_order.description: Slide IDs in talk order; default is the slide positions

name: create_presentation_variant
